title: Geekvape Z Series Coils
description: GeekVape Z Series Coils (Z XM Boost Version) are the reliable engine behind some of the most popular sub-ohm kits in the world, including the GeekVape L200 and the Z Sub-Ohm Tank (Zeus). These replacement coils are designed to be easy to install and incredibly durable, making them perfect for vapers looking for a consistent, hassle-free experience. The "XM" versions included in this range are built for daily vaping endurance. They use a specific type of mesh that lasts significantly longer than standard coils, meaning you spend less time changing coils and more time enjoying your favourite flavours. This boosted lifespan accompanies the smooth, warm vapour and rich taste that GeekVape is famous for. These coils are best used with High-VG e-liquids (70% VG or higher) to achieve the best results. The push-fit design allows you to swap them out in seconds without any messy threading. Simply pull the old coil out and push the new one in to continue vaping immediately. Previously Labelled: Mesh Z1 coil/ G Coil Zeus Formula
